requirements.shall: Every node/runtime/network/storage/control-plane assumption SHALL be catalogued and, where feasible, checked at startup.

requirements.requirement: Define success, partial success, degraded operation, retryable failure, and terminal failure semantics for Wasm deployment manager.
requirements.shall: Every response SHALL carry one of SUCCESS, PARTIAL, DEGRADED, RETRYABLE, TERMINAL with defined semantics.

requirements.requirement: Define lifecycle states and legal state transitions managed or exposed by Wasm deployment manager.
requirements.shall: Lifecycle states and legal transitions SHALL be defined and illegal transitions rejected.

requirements.requirement: Define versioning and backward-compatibility requirements for Wasm deployment manager.
requirements.shall: Contracts SHALL be semver'd by schema major; minors additive; deprecations dated; the legacy Manager API preserved.

requirements.requirement: Define capacity ceilings, quotas, and fairness semantics relevant to Wasm deployment manager.
requirements.shall: Per-tenant instance quotas, request-rate fairness and global capacity ceilings SHALL be enforced.

requirements.requirement: Define behavior when network connectivity is intermittent or absent.
requirements.shall: With intermittent/absent connectivity the manager SHALL journal intents, report DEGRADED within the autonomy window, fail RETRYABLE beyond it, and resynchronise on reconnect.

requirements.requirement: Define precedence rules when Wasm deployment manager requirements conflict with security, residency, SLO, or cost constraints.
requirements.shall: Conflicts SHALL resolve in precedence security > residency > consistency > SLO > cost.

requirements.shall: Every exposed boundary SHALL be inventoried with contract, authN, authZ, timeout, limits and owner.

requirements.requirement: Use versioned typed schemas for all externally visible Wasm deployment manager contracts.
requirements.shall: Every external contract SHALL have a versioned JSON schema validated at the boundary.

requirements.requirement: Define authentication requirements at each Wasm deployment manager boundary.
requirements.shall: Every inbound boundary SHALL authenticate callers (signed, expiring, replay-protected tokens).

requirements.requirement: Define authorization and explicit capability requirements at each Wasm deployment manager boundary.
requirements.shall: Every operation SHALL require an explicit capability, scoped to the caller's tenant.

requirements.requirement: Define timeout, cancellation, retry, idempotency, and backpressure semantics for Wasm deployment manager.
requirements.shall: Timeouts, cancellation, retries (idempotent only), idempotency keys and backpressure SHALL be defined and enforced.

requirements.requirement: Define structured failure codes and machine-readable error details for Wasm deployment manager.
requirements.shall: Every failure SHALL be a stable code with retryability and machine-readable details.

requirements.requirement: Define compatibility behavior when peers use different supported versions.
requirements.shall: Peers SHALL negotiate the highest common schema major and fail closed when none exists.

requirements.requirement: Document payload, concurrency, queue, connection, or resource limits at Wasm deployment manager interfaces.

requirements.requirement: Separate immutable artifacts from mutable configuration and state for Wasm deployment manager.
requirements.shall: Immutable package, mutable config and mutable state SHALL be physically separate.

requirements.requirement: Define declarative configuration and secure defaults for Wasm deployment manager.
requirements.shall: Configuration SHALL be declarative with secure defaults (prod profile by default).

requirements.requirement: Validate configuration before activation and fail closed on security-critical errors.
requirements.shall: Configuration SHALL be validated before activation and fail closed on security-critical errors.

requirements.requirement: Support site- and environment-specific configuration without rebuilding immutable artifacts.
requirements.shall: Site/environment overlays SHALL change behaviour without rebuilding the package.

requirements.requirement: Record configuration provenance, version, author, and activation time.
requirements.shall: Each activation SHALL record version, digest, author, time, reason and previous digest.

requirements.requirement: Apply atomic or transactional configuration updates where partial application is unsafe.
requirements.shall: Configuration activation SHALL be atomic (all-or-nothing).

requirements.requirement: Define automatic and operator-driven rollback for failed Wasm deployment manager changes.
requirements.shall: Failed rollouts SHALL auto-rollback; operators SHALL be able to roll back workloads and configuration.

requirements.requirement: Keep credentials and secret material out of ordinary Wasm deployment manager configuration and diagnostics.
requirements.shall: Secrets SHALL appear only as refs (env:/file:) and SHALL be redacted from logs, traces and errors.

requirements.requirement: Provide a deterministic bootstrap path from an empty node/environment to healthy Wasm deployment manager operation.
requirements.shall: Bootstrap from an empty node SHALL be deterministic and gated by preflight.

requirements.requirement: Threat-model Wasm deployment manager against malicious tenants, compromised workloads, hostile inputs, supply-chain compromise, and control-plane abuse.
requirements.shall: A STRIDE threat model SHALL cover tenants, workloads, inputs, supply chain, control plane and insiders, each threat mapped to controls and tests.

requirements.requirement: Apply least privilege to every identity and capability used by Wasm deployment manager.
requirements.shall: Each role SHALL hold the minimum capability set; platform principals SHALL NOT mutate tenant workloads.

requirements.requirement: Eliminate ambient filesystem, network, device, kernel, and secret authority wherever Wasm deployment manager permits.
requirements.shall: The service SHALL use only injected handles (adapter, journal dir); no ambient FS/network/device/secret authority.

requirements.requirement: Authenticate nodes, peers, artifacts, providers, and control-plane actors before trust is granted.
requirements.shall: Nodes, peers, artifacts, providers and controllers SHALL be authenticated before trust.

requirements.requirement: Verify signatures, digests, provenance, and approved versions for executable or policy artifacts consumed by Wasm deployment manager.
requirements.shall: Artifacts SHALL be verified by digest, Ed25519 signature from a trusted key id, approved version and revocation list before deploy or rollout.

requirements.requirement: Enforce tenant/workload isolation across Wasm deployment manager execution, memory, state, network, and device boundaries as applicable.
requirements.shall: Tenant state, identifiers, quotas and placement SHALL be isolated.

requirements.requirement: Encrypt sensitive Wasm deployment manager data in transit and at rest with managed key rotation.
requirements.shall: Sensitive state SHALL be encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) with key ids and rotation; transit SHALL use the transport's TLS/mTLS.

requirements.requirement: Define safe behavior when identity, attestation, policy, key, or time services are unavailable.
requirements.shall: When identity, key, verifier or time services are unavailable the manager SHALL fail closed.

requirements.requirement: Emit tamper-evident audit events for security-sensitive Wasm deployment manager operations.
requirements.shall: Security-sensitive operations SHALL emit hash-chained, fsync'd audit records; tampering SHALL be detected at load.

requirements.requirement: Run adversarial tests for privilege escalation, injection, replay, spoofing, escape, side channels, and resource exhaustion.

requirements.requirement: Define automated health and stall detection thresholds for Wasm deployment manager.
requirements.shall: Health and stall thresholds SHALL be defined and detected automatically.

requirements.requirement: Implement bounded retry with backoff and jitter only where operations are safe to retry.
requirements.shall: Retries SHALL be bounded, jittered and limited to idempotent operations and retryable errors.

requirements.requirement: Implement admission control, load shedding, or circuit breaking to prevent Wasm deployment manager failure cascades.
requirements.shall: Admission control, priority shedding and circuit breaking SHALL prevent cascades.

requirements.requirement: Define failover behavior without violating isolation, residency, or consistency requirements.
requirements.shall: Failover SHALL NOT violate isolation, residency or consistency (fenced leader; residency-constrained placement).

requirements.requirement: Provide degraded operation when noncritical dependencies are unavailable.
requirements.shall: Non-critical dependency loss SHALL degrade (not fail) the service.

requirements.requirement: Define crash-consistency, restart, resume, or replay semantics for mutable Wasm deployment manager state.
requirements.shall: State SHALL be crash-consistent; restart SHALL replay the journal and truncate only torn tails.

requirements.requirement: Protect against split-brain, duplicate ownership, stale controllers, or duplicate execution where relevant.
requirements.shall: Stale controllers SHALL be fenced by epoch; concurrent writers SHALL be detected.
